title: Specified strict projection and pullback realization corners
statement: Let $A$ have adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$ be scheme morphisms. Use ordinary and strict completed-ring pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], strict reduction $R_T$ and the canonical pullback/reduction isomorphism $\chi_u:L_u^{\rm Tow}R_T\simeq R_SL_u^*$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-four-towers], and the canonical proper projection map $p_u:R_TRu_*\to R_u^{\rm Tow}R_S$ [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. For $K\in D(A_X)$ define $H:R_{Y'}Lg^*Rf_*K\simeq L_g^{\rm Tow}R_f^{\rm Tow}R_XK$ by $\chi_g^{-1}$ followed by $L_g^{\rm Tow}(p_f)$, and define $H':R_{Y'}Rf'_*Lg'^*K\simeq R_{f'}^{\rm Tow}L_{g'}^{\rm Tow}R_XK$ by $p_{f'}$ followed by $R_{f'}^{\rm Tow}(\chi_{g'}^{-1})$. These are exactly exchangeRealizationH and exchangeRealizationHPrime before any evaluation or inverse limit. No exchange-commutation equation is part of this definition.
